classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: A class representing a WebSocket route handler that allows mocking, intercepting, connecting to the actual WebSocket server, and handling WebSocket lifecycle events within the web automation context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes one side of the WebSocket connection, with optional close code and reason.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Connects the WebSocket route to the actual server and returns a server-side WebSocketRoute instance for sending and receiving messages.

methods.name: onClose

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Sets up a handler to process incoming WebSocket messages, either from the page or the server.
